paper_claim: Lung-on-chip exposing the alveolar-capillary barrier to 'fluid dynamic forces that mimic blood flow'; cyclic strain 5-15% at 0.2 Hz reported, but no explicit wall-shear magnitude and no full channel geometry are stated.
note: Reproducibility finding: this foundational paper describes fluid shear qualitatively but reports neither a shear magnitude nor the channel geometry/flow needed to recompute it. The verifier cannot check an unstated claim. This is exactly the gap the tool exists to close.
